findings.evidence: The base `effectiveActionFunctor` (TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Groupoid/ActionCategory/Effective.lean:35) is not exposed; grep for `expose` in that directory finds no hits, and it ships `effectiveActionFunctor_obj` with `:= (rfl)` (l.44). The PR's EssSurj instance for `toQuotientKer` relies on the definitional unfolding that this missing obj lemma should provide.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` from all three. Add the missing obj lemmas: `toQuotientKer_obj_objEquiv : (toQuotientKer hker).obj (Effective.objEquiv G X x) = ActionCategory.objEquiv _ X x` (with `:= (rfl)`), and `Effective.objEquiv_symm_toEffective_obj : (Effective.objEquiv G X).symm ((toEffective G X).obj a) = a.back`.
findings.issue: `toEffective` (l.108), `Effective.objEquiv` (l.118) and `Effective.toQuotientKer` (l.~177) are `@[expose]`, but nothing outside the module needs to unfold them. The only in-file defeq uses are `(rfl)` lemmas and same-module instance proofs, so the exposure substitutes for missing lemmas.

findings.evidence: `toQuotientKer` is `CategoryTheory.Quotient.lift (germRel G X) (effectiveActionFunctor G X) …`. The type ascription to `Effective G X ⥤ _` only typechecks because `Effective` unfolds to `CategoryTheory.Quotient (germRel G X)`.
findings.fix: Add `Effective.lift (F : ActionCategory G X ⥤ D) (H : ∀ a b (f f' : a ⟶ b), germRel G X f f' → F.map f = F.map f') : Effective G X ⥤ D`. Also add `toEffective_comp_lift` (`toEffective G X ⋙ lift F H = F`), a `lift_map_toEffective_map` simp lemma, and a uniqueness/ext lemma for functors out of `Effective` (the analogue of `Quotient.lift_unique`). Then redefine `toQuotientKer` via `Effective.lift` and drop `@[expose]` from `Effective`.
findings.issue: `Effective` has no universal property of its own. The only way to build a functor out of it is to unfold the `@[expose]` body and call `CategoryTheory.Quotient.lift`, which is exactly how `toQuotientKer` is defined.

summary: The surface exposes the bodies of `toEffective`, `Effective.objEquiv` and `Effective.toQuotientKer` because the file lacks their characteristic lemmas. `Effective` has no universal property of its own, so a consumer must unfold it to `CategoryTheory.Quotient`.
